title: 🔥宏观指标处于避险压制区
body: 市场正面临宏观流动性紧缩周期。BMRI数值为74，处于RISK_OFF区间，显示资金风险偏好极低。结合当前市场等待油价下跌重燃降息预期的现状，该指标确认了外部环境并未改善，存量资金在避险情绪主导下难以推动资产趋势反转。偏空。宏观宽松何时来临？
body_en: The market is facing a macro liquidity tightening cycle. BMRI is at 74, sitting in the RISK_OFF zone, signaling extremely low risk appetite. With the market waiting for oil prices to drop to reignite rate cut expectations, this indicator confirms the external environment hasn't improved. Existing capital, dominated by risk-averse sentiment, cannot drive an asset trend reversal. Bearish. When will macro easing arrive?
